purpose: Show a nonnegative categorical distribution with totals and an optional exact-data table.
behaviorProvider: Recharts Pie/PieChart with shared ChartContainer, ChartLegend and ChartDataTable.

component: Copy each datum and convert nonfinite values to zero, clamping finite negatives to zero. Compute both total and rendered slices from those normalized values.
Treat a zero normalized total as empty even when the data array contains records; delegate loading/error/empty precedence to ChartContainer.
Use each explicit semantic ChartColor or the repeating categorical chartPalette. Disable slice and tooltip animation and enable the Recharts accessibility layer with a category-inspection label.
host: Provide unique meaningful category names, a totalLabel and surrounding quantitative explanation. Use a table or equivalent textual summary for comparisons and totals beyond the visual center.
Only use this normalization for quantities where negatives and nonfinite values may be represented as zero; validate and report invalid source data upstream when silent coercion would mislead.

requirements.statement: Copy each datum and convert nonfinite values to zero, clamping finite negatives to zero. Compute both total and rendered slices from those normalized values.

Use each explicit semantic ChartColor or the repeating categorical chartPalette. Disable slice and tooltip animation and enable the Recharts accessibility layer with a category-inspection label.
When enabled, show static legend entries containing each category name and normalized localized value. Donut legend items do not toggle slices.
Display the normalized en-GB total and totalLabel in an aria-hidden center overlay, so hosts must not treat that overlay as an accessible total announcement.
When requested and records exist, provide ChartDataTable for normalized category values, including a zero-total state because ChartContainer footer is independent from plot state.
Provide unique meaningful category names, a totalLabel and surrounding quantitative explanation. Use a table or equivalent textual summary for comparisons and totals beyond the visual center.
Only use this normalization for quantities where negatives and nonfinite values may be represented as zero; validate and report invalid source data upstream when silent coercion would mislead.
Consume data-viz group tokens for this family; nested shared components retain their declared ownership. Keep theme/mode changes in token mappings rather than branching behavioral code.

limitations: No slice selection, legend toggle, sorting, aggregation or percentage labels are implemented.
The accessible center total is not announced; category inspection and optional table do not replace a domain-specific written summary.
